## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.3.1

### Overview

0.3.1 is a patch release of 0.3.0. It fixes one defect in
`sapintegrationsuite_access_policy`: descriptions longer than SAP can store
are now rejected while Terraform plans, instead of failing the apply after
the policy has already been created. Nothing else changes.

### Fixed behavior

SAP Integration Suite keeps at most 200 characters of an access policy
description. 0.3.0 accepted longer descriptions. On a tenant, this played out
as follows:

1. The provider created the policy. SAP accepted the request and stored only
   the first 200 characters of the description.
2. The provider read the policy back. The description no longer matched the
   plan, so Terraform stopped with "Provider produced inconsistent result
   after apply".
3. The `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference` resources depend on the
   policy's `id`, so Terraform never created them.

What remained in SAP was a policy with its role and a truncated description,
but without the references that define what it protects.

0.3.1 checks the description length when Terraform validates the
configuration. A description of more than 200 characters now fails the plan
with an error that names the limit and the length found, and SAP is not
called. The provider does not shorten the text itself; a silently cut
description would hide the configuration error.

```terraform
# Rejected by 0.3.1 at plan time; created and then failed with 0.3.0
resource "sapintegrationsuite_access_policy" "core" {
  role_name   = "CORE_LWW_DEVELOPER"
  description = "Developers of CORE/LWW may edit integration flows whose names start with CORE_LWW_, value mappings ... (several hundred characters)"
}

# Accepted: a short summary; the scope belongs in the references
resource "sapintegrationsuite_access_policy" "core" {
  role_name   = "CORE_LWW_DEVELOPER"
  description = "CORE/LWW developer access to owned Cloud Integration artifacts."
}
```

SAP Help, the Business Accelerator Hub specification and the service's
`$metadata` state no length for this field; the limit was observed on a
tenant.

### Affected resource

- `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy`, attribute `description`.

The data sources and `sapintegrationsuite_access_policy_reference` are
unchanged.

### Upgrade guidance

- No resource is renamed and no state is migrated. If all access policy
  descriptions have 200 characters or fewer, upgrading needs no change.
- If a description is longer, `terraform plan` now fails. Shorten it to a
  summary of who the policy is for.
- A policy that 0.3.0 created with a truncated description is reconciled
  after the description is shortened. If it is in the state as tainted, the
  next apply replaces it; `terraform untaint` keeps it instead, and an
  in-place description change then needs `enable_unofficial = true`. If it is
  not in the state, import it by its numeric ID or delete it in SAP before
  applying, because a second policy with the same role name cannot be
  created. The references are created by the same apply.

The Provider Upgrades guide on the Terraform Registry walks through both
cases.

### Known impact

- Configurations that relied on long descriptions must be shortened. SAP
  never kept more than 200 characters, so no information that was stored in
  SAP is lost.
- Characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as emoji, count as
  two characters. How SAP counts them was not tested, so the provider takes
  the stricter count.
